subject: English
question_text: Why do all people go to National Memorial?
guide_solution: On 26 March people of all classes go to the NatiOnal Mausoleum at Savar to pay homage to the martyrs of Liberation War in 1971. They also remember the great struggle and sacrifice of the freedom fighters.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Dinajpur Board-2020 (CF Board Ques)

subject: English
question_text: How is the Independence Day observed?
guide_solution: The Independence Day is observed with great enthusiasm and fervour. The day starts with 31 gunshots. People from all walks of life place floral wreaths at the National Mausoleum. Besides, parade shows, displays, cultural programmes, sports are held to celebrate 26 March.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Dinajpur Board-2020 (CF Board Ques)

subject: English
question_text: Who pay homage to the martyred freedom fighterS?
guide_solution: The President and the Prime Minister place floral wreaths on behalf of the nation at the National Mausoleum. People from all walks of life also go there to pay homage to the martyred freedom fighters.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Dinajpur Board-2020 (CF Board Ques)

subject: English
question_text: What does the country witness at the National Parade Ground this day?
guide_solution: This day the country witnesses a spectacular parade of defence forces, border guards, police, ansars and the VDP (Village Defence Party) at the National Parade Ground.
